method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: analyze_land
tools.description: Generates a comprehensive land analysis report for a US property through one of four analytical lenses: off_grid, rural_residential, recreational, or investment. Call this when the user asks for a full analysis of a specific property. If the user's intent is unclear, ask which mode to use before calling. Returns a report ID and poll URL — the final structured report (scores, confidence ratings, narrative summary, source citations) is delivered asynchronously via polling or webhook. Consumes one analysis credit from your AcreLens account.

address.description: Full street address of the US property (e.g. "123 Cabin Rd, Taos, NM").

mode.description: Analysis lens: off_grid, rural_residential, recreational, or investment.

county.description: County name (recommended for better regulation research).

report_id.description: Unique ID for the report. Use this with the poll URL to retrieve the final structured report.

status.description: Report status. Initially "authorized" or "processing"; transitions to "completed" or "failed" once analysis finishes.

mode.description: The analysis lens that was applied (echoed from the request).

estimated_completion_seconds.description: Approximate seconds until the report is ready. Use as a hint for when to first poll.

poll_url.description: Absolute URL to GET the report. Returns 202 while processing, 200 with full body once completed.

tools.name: get_land_quick_score
tools.description: Get a fast suitability score (0-100) for a US property without generating a full report. Call this when the user wants a quick go/no-go assessment or an initial screening before committing to a full analysis. Returns a single score with confidence level and one-sentence rationale. Consumes a partial (0.25) analysis credit from your AcreLens account.

address.description: Full street address of the US property.

mode.description: Analysis lens: off_grid, rural_residential, recreational, or investment.

report_id.description: Unique ID for the underlying quick-mode report.

status.description: "completed" when the score is ready; "processing" if the poll timed out and the caller should retry the report later.

score.description: Overall suitability score 0-100. Null while still processing.

confidence.description: Aggregate confidence level derived from per-category confidences. Null while still processing.

summary.description: One-sentence rationale for the score. Null while still processing or if no summary was generated.

tools.name: get_state_land_profile
tools.description: Retrieve state-level land intelligence data covering regulation, climate, solar potential, water access, and building codes. Call this when the user wants general context about a US state before drilling into a specific property. Returns structured multi-mode profiles.

mode.description: Optional mode filter. If omitted, returns all 4 modes.

state_code.description: 2-letter US state code echoed from the request.

overall_score.description: Aggregate suitability score 0-100 for this mode.

sub_scores.description: Per-category sub-scores (solar, water, regulation, climate, etc.) keyed by category name.

summary.description: Narrative summary of state-level conditions for this mode.

key_regulations.description: Notable state-level regulations affecting land use under this mode.

modes.description: Per-mode profile data, keyed by mode name (off_grid, rural_residential, recreational, investment). Contains the requested mode if a filter was provided, otherwise all four.

shared_facts.description: Cross-mode state-level facts (statute citations, agency names, etc.) that apply across all modes.

tools.name: compare_properties
tools.description: Compare 2–5 US properties side by side using the same analysis mode. Call this when the user is evaluating multiple parcels or listings and wants a comparative view. Kicks off the analyses asynchronously and returns a batch ID plus one report ID per property (in input order) to poll — scored results arrive via polling or the batch webhook, not inline. Consumes one analysis credit per property from your AcreLens account.

address.description: Full street address of the US property.

mode.description: Analysis lens to apply to every property.

batch_id.description: Unique batch ID grouping the report jobs created by this call.

report_ids.description: Per-property report IDs in the same order as the input properties array. Poll each individually or wait for the batch.completed webhook.

status.description: Batch status. Initially "processing"; transitions to "completed" once all per-property reports terminate.

tools.name: get_solar_potential
tools.description: Estimate solar energy production potential for a US address using NREL PVWatts data. Call this when the user asks about solar power viability, off-grid energy, or panel sizing. Returns estimated annual production and a typical installed-cost bracket for the system size you specify (default 5 kW).

address.description: US street address (used for geocoding fallback).

annual_kwh.description: Estimated annual AC electricity production in kilowatt-hours, from NREL PVWatts.

system_size_kw.description: System nameplate capacity in kilowatts (echoed from the request, default 5).

latitude.description: Latitude used for the calculation. Will be the resolved geocoded value if address was provided instead of lat/lng.

longitude.description: Longitude used for the calculation. Will be the resolved geocoded value if address was provided instead of lat/lng.

cost_bracket.description: Typical installed-cost range (USD) for a system of this size. Indicative only; varies by region and installer.
